sermon.title: A new day! - December 31, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: On the last Sunday of 2023, the speaker gives reminders for the new year: God’s commandments, not culture, define love and harm; the Holy Spirit is our armor bearer; Christ’s word stills every wind of doctrine; grace means being under the influence of Christ; and nameless believers with the hand of the Lord can do great things. The goal for 2024 is to let the river of life flow.

Names in the “elenor… breo whittier” line are unclear in the captions and left as captioned.

faqs.question: What are they looking forward to?
faqs.answer: A wonderful new year 2024 and their own development as Christians, reaching the world with the Gospel.

faqs.question: Can I follow my own definition?
faqs.answer: You can get into your own book, but your own book is going to burn up.

faqs.question: What image does he use for being unequipped?
faqs.answer: Being parachuted in bare with nothing; God doesn’t want that.

faqs.question: What does God’s spoken word do?
faqs.answer: It cuts through all the junk and shuts down the world’s message.

faqs.question: Does the speaker ever get discouraged?
faqs.answer: Yes, tired and upset by the world advancing; but it’s by design.

faqs.question: Why is there a time of response?
faqs.answer: Because that’s how he met Jesus, to give you an opportunity to meet with your God.

faqs.question: What matters more than cathedrals?
faqs.answer: Starving and dirty kids are more valuable to God than all the marble and paintings.

faqs.question: What if I’m a nobody?
faqs.answer: Get the hand of the Lord upon you and He can do great things.

faqs.question: Should I leave it to those with credentials?
faqs.answer: No; God is looking at you and me.

faqs.question: When do we overcome the beast?
faqs.answer: Now; whether the beast is Satan or something Satan created, he wants victory over it now.
